title: steamTables operation
description: IAPWS-IF97 industrial water/steam properties. This is a propsDict operation under choupoProps (like propertyPoint), NOT a flowsheet unit. At startup it self-checks the transcribed coefficients against the release verification tables and REFUSES the run on any deviation above 1e-8. Give exactly ONE mode block per operation: point, saturation or isobar. CSV columns are canonical SI (h, u, s, cp, cv in J/kg-based units). Tutorial tutorials/props/steam/steam01_if97_verification locks every release verification table as a golden KPI at reltol 1e-8.

point.title: Single (p,T) state
point.description: One state point. Reports v, rho, h, u, s, cp, cv, w and the IF97 region, printed and stored as diagnostics (psat at T rides along as a free verification pin). An output { file ...; } block is optional here and writes a one-row CSV.

saturation.title: Saturation-line scan
saturation.description: Temperature scan along the saturation line: psat plus the saturated liquid/vapour pairs (v, h, s) and h_fg per row. Valid over 273.15-623.15 K only — above that the liquid side is region 3 and the scan is refused loudly. An output { file ...; } block is required.

isobar.title: Isobaric scan
isobar.description: h, s, v and cp versus temperature at fixed pressure. A subcritical isobar's saturation crossing is ANNOUNCED before the scan, so the h/s/v jump is expected rather than surprising. Regions 3 and 5 are refused loudly. An output { file ...; } block is required.

output.title: CSV output
output.description: `{ file <name>.csv; }` — required by the `saturation` and `isobar` scans, optional for `point` (it writes a one-row CSV).
